controls.interact: INTERACT WIT OR DISMANTLE AN OBJECT
controls.zoomHold: HOLD L2 AN' PUSH DA RIGHT STICK

m721_zone.title: HYDROPONIC
m721_zone.text: WE CAN USE DIS HYDROPONIC ROOM TA GROW EARTH FOOD IN DA DEPTHS OF SPACE!

storyModeWaterfall.title: SECRET CAVES
storyModeWaterfall.text: WE SHOULD CHECK BEHIND EVERY WATERFALL: STATISTICALLY SPEAKIN', ABOUT 30% OF DEM HAB A SECRET CAVE BEHIND DEM!

m1006_zone.title: HORSE BETTIN'
m1006_zone.text: IZ YOU FEELIN' YA LUDOPATHY COMIN' BACK? DAT IZ A GOOD SIGN DAT YA MEMORIES IZ RETURNIN', EM! WHY NO YOU BET ON HORSES? MAYBE SOMETHIN' ELSE WILL RESURFACE!

m1006_zone2.title: MONSTER TOURNAMENT
m1006_zone2.text: USE DIS TERMINAL TA WATCH AN' BET ON MONSTER FIGHTS. ME NO REALLY KNOW IF DEY IZ REAL MONSTERS FIGHTIN' FOR DEY LIVES OR SIMULATED BATTLES; MAYBE IT IZ BEST TA JUST NO KNOW!

m1006_zone3.title: COIN CONVERSION
m1006_zone3.text: USE DIS MACHINE TA CONVERT EUROS TA TOKENS USED FOR MINIGAMES AN' SLOT MACHINES. YOU ALSO HAB A [HYPERDECK] APP FOR DAT!

m1006_zone4.title: SLOT MACHINE
m1006_zone4.text: ME HEARD RUMORS OF A CURSED SLOT IN DIS CASINO!

m1023_zone.title: GHENT HOSPITAL
m1023_zone.text: VISIT HOSPITALS TA GET OUR DISEASES DIAGNOSED, INSTALL AUGMENTS, CHANGE BODY PARTS AN' ACCESS DA [FERTILITY DATABASE]. ME NO EXACTLY PICTURE YOU AS A MOTHER FIGURE, BUT IF YOU WANT TA HELP REPOPULATE DA EARTH, GO AHEAD!

m1414_zone.title: INN
m1414_zone.text: IZ YOU FEELIN' TIRED, EM? OR DO YOU NEED TA HIRE SOME MUSCLE TA SUPPORT YA HEXIN'? VISIT INNS AN' TAVERNS TA RENT A ROOM AN' TALK TA OTHER ADVENTURERS!

m1414_zone2.title: HYPERMETRO TRAINS
m1414_zone2.text:
WE CAN MOVE BETWEEN HUB CITIES USING DA HYPERMETRO! OUR FINAL DESTINATION IZ DA OMEGA TOWER, BUT WE SHOULD STOP AT GHENT TA STOCK UP ON ITEMS. 
NO WORRY, DARLIN', IF WE LEAVE OUR [CAMPER] BEHIND: IT CAN BE SUMMONED BY JOININ' OUR [LIMINAL CUFFS]!

m1414_zone3.title: CRAFTIN'
m1414_zone3.text:
IN DIS SHACK WE CAN FIND SOME MATERIALS. IT BELONGS TA XOR DA TRASH GOBLIN; ME WILL REPAY HIM LATER IF WE TAKE SOMETHIN' FROM HERE.
YOU CAN USE DA [THINKER] OPTION IN [MENU] TA ASSEMBLE ANYTHIN' YOU HAB DA TECHNICAL SKILLS FOR!

m1414_zone4.title: FARMIN' PLOTS
m1414_zone4.text:
WE CAN USE FARMIN' PLOTS TA GROW OUR OWN PLANTS, OR JUST TAKE WHAT WE FIND. 
JUST MAKE SURE TA PAY DA OWNER OF DA PLOT BACK, OK?

m1414_zone5.title: HIGH LEVEL BAD 'UNS
m1414_zone5.text: DARLIN', DEZE PILES OF SENTIENT TRASH IZ TOO STRONG EVEN FOR A WANNABE WITCH LIKE YOU. MAY ME SUGGEST YOU JUST IGNORE DEM UNTIL YOU CAN CALL YOURSELF A PROPER WITCH?

m1414_zone7.title: DUNGEON
m1414_zone7.text: DIS DUNGEON SHOULD BE A PROPER CHALLENGE TA RELEARN YA COMBAT SKILLS! DID ME MENTION DAT YOU CAN MODIFY YA [VECTOR GUN] IN DA [MENU]? YOU CAN ADAPT ITS ALTERNATE FORM OR ELEMENT TA PREPARE FOR ANY SITUATION, AN' IN DIS DUNGEON FIRE DAMAGE WILL HELP!

m1414_zone10.title: APIARY
m1414_zone10.text:
"IF DA BEE DISAPPEARED OFF DA SURFACE OF DA NOOSPHERE, DEN MAN WOULD ONLY HAB FOUR YEARS OF LIFE LEFT." 
GOOD OLD ALEISTER CROWLEY SAID DAT!

m1414_zone11.title: FARM
m1414_zone11.text:
WE CAN TAKE OVER DIS ABANDONED FARM: ITS OWNER WAZ RECENTLY KILLED BY SATELLITE DEBRIS AN' NOBODY HAB CLAIMED IT YET.
USE DA [BUILD] OPTION IN DA PAUSE MENU TA BUY SOME ANIMALS, BUT DO DIS ONLY IF YOU WANT TA ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT DEM! DO YOU REMEMBER WHAT DA ARCHIVISTS DID TA OUR SHEEP DOLLY? ME WILL NEVER FORGIVE DEM FOR DAT!

m1414_zone9.title: LIBRARY
m1414_zone9.text: LIBRARIES IZ A GREAT PLACE TA FIND NEW GRIMORIES, HUNTIN' DEM WAZ YA PRIMARY HOBBY BEFORE YA MIND GOT WIPED!

m1414_zone12.title: CLINIC
m1414_zone12.text: IF YOU NO FEEL WELL, DARLIN', HEAD TA A CLINIC: DERE YOU CAN GET A PROPER DIAGNOSIS AN' TREATMENT. AN' IF YOU NEED A LITERAL HAND, YOU CAN GET NEW BODY PARTS INSTALLED AN' ALSO AUGMENTS FOR YA BODY!

m1416_zone.title: PC
m1416_zone.text: USE DIS PUBLIC PC TA ACCESS HYPERNET, YOU CAN ALSO USE DA [HYPERDECK] IF YOU NO TRUST PUTTIN' YA CREDENTIALS IN PUBLIC PCS!

m1416_zone2.title: QUEST BOARD
m1416_zone2.text: YOU CAN USE DA QUEST BOARD TA ACCEPT QUESTS, AN' YOU CAN EVEN WRITE YA OWN TA BE COMPLETED BY OTHER ADVENTURERS!

m1416_zone4.title: BATHROOM
m1416_zone4.text: USE BATHROOMS TA WASH AN' RAISE YA HYGIENE. HYGIENE MATTERS WHEN YOU TALK TA SOMEONE, UNLESS DEY DO NO CARE ABOUT IT!

m1416_zone5.title: INNKEEPER
m1416_zone5.text: TALK TA DA INNKEEPER TA RENT A ROOM, BUY FOOD OR RECRUIT TROOPS. YES, YOU HEARD RIGHT! WE CAN RAISE AN ARMY IF WE HAB DA FUNDS, AN' INNS IZ A GOOD PLACE TA START. LETZ HAB A BEER TA OUR FUTURE INDEPENDENT SOVEREIGN NATION!

m1416_zone15.title: BATHROOM
m1416_zone15.text: USE BATHROOMS TA WASH AN' RAISE YA HYGIENE. HYGIENE MATTERS WHEN YOU TALK TA SOMEONE, UNLESS DEY DO NO CARE ABOUT IT!

m1416_zone19.title: LIL' GAMES
m1416_zone19.text: WE CAN INCREASE OUR MOOD BY PLAYIN' GAMES. SOME WILL NEED GAME TOKENS, AN' WE CAN USE DIS CONVERTER OR DA [HYPERDECK] APP TA BUY DEM!

m1416_zone10.title: RENTIN'
m1416_zone10.text: INTERACT WIT DA DOOR OR TALK TA DA INNKEEPER TA RENT A ROOM. NO SLEEPIN' WILL MAKE YOU START LOSIN' MP AN' DEN GOING INSANE, SO MAKE SURE TA REST!

m136_zone.title: OMEGA TOWER ENTRANCE
m136_zone.text: HERE WE IZ, EM! DIS IZ DA ENTRANCE OF DA [OMEGA TOWER]: HERE YOU HAB TOTAL IMMUNITY FOR YA ACCIDENTAL DEICIDE!

m169_zone.title: ABANDONED FARM
m169_zone.text: INSTEAD OF GOING TA DA OMEGA TOWER FOR IMMUNITY, WE CAN ALSO JUST TAKE OVER DIS ABANDONED FARM AN' STAY DERE UNTIL THINGS CALM DOWN. WE CAN ACTUALLY CLAIM ANY ABANDONED HOUSE WE ENCOUNTER AN' START PLACIN' STRUCTURES WIT DA [BUILD] OPTION OF DA PAUSE MENU!

m169_zone2.title: TRASH
m169_zone2.text:
AH! TRASHDIVIN'! DA LOTTERY OF DA BRAVE! 
WE CAN FIND TRULY MARVELOUS GEMS DAT SURVIVED DA Y2K EVENT BURIED IN TRASH. 
ME THINK DA TRASH SHIELDED DEM FROM DA [EHI] ERUPTION AN' PRESERVED MOST OF DA CIRCUITS. 
MAKE SURE TA WASH YOURSELF, BECAUSE BEING [OILY] MAKES YOU VULNERABLE TA FIRE ATTACKS!

m169_zone3.title: CHAOS
m169_zone3.text:
WE NEED TA GET DA HEX OUT OF HERE, EM! DA [FIFTH DIMENSION] IZ POURIN' FROM HOLES IN REALITY, AN' WE CAN EASILY FALL INTO ONE AN' END UP IN DA [WHITE DESERT].
IT IZ NO A NICE PLACE, EM. ME SPENT EONS TRAPPED DERE IN 1997 BEFORE YOU BROKE DA LAWS OF SPACETIME TA STASH ME!

m169_zone6.title: SACRIFICIAL ALTAR
m169_zone6.text: DIS PLACE REEKS OF GASOLINE, SOMETHIN' POWERFUL IZ BURIED DERE!

m169_zone7.title: GOBLINS
m169_zone7.text:
TRUST ME, EM, JUST LEAVE NAKUGA GOBLINS ALONE. LET DEM DO DEY THING AN' JUST AVOID DEM IF DEY TRY TA ENGAGE IN BATTLE. 
WE SHARE A COMMON ANCESTOR AN' MOST OF OUR DNA WIT DEM, SO DEY IZ OUR PSIONIC BLACK METAL LOVIN' BROTHERS.
VERDEN GOBLINS, INSTEAD, IZ A TOTALLY DIFFERENT ALIEN SPECIES DAT JUST HAPPENS TA LOOK LIKE EARTH GOBLINS DUE TA DA GENETIC LOTTERY. DEY IZ CHILL AN' TOTALLY INTEGRATED WIT HUMAN SOCIETY; MOST GOBLINS YOU SEE IN TOWN IZ VERDEN GOBLINS!

m169_zone8.title: BLOCK PUSHIN' PUZZLE
m169_zone8.text:
TRY TA SOLVE DIS SIMPLE BLOCK PUSHIN' PUZZLE AN' LET ME EVALUATE YA MENTAL SKILLS AFTER YA MEMORY WIPE.
MOVE TOWARD DAT BOULDER TA PUSH IT AN' HOLD [ACTION] TA DRAG IT WIT YOU

m689_zone.title: HARDWARE STORES
m689_zone.text: YOU CAN UPGRADE YA [HYPERDECK] BY FINDIN' NEW COMPONENTS IN HARDWARE STORES, WE CAN ALSO FIND ALL SORT OF USEFUL TOOLS HERE!

m689_zone3.title: GARAGE
m689_zone3.text: WE CAN BUY NEW VEHICLES IN GARAGES, LIKE CARS, BOATS OR EVEN A BROOMSTICK!

m689_zone5.title: MAGES GUILD
m689_zone5.text:
IT IZ A BIT HIDDEN, BUT DIS IZ DA ENTRANCE TA DA GHENT MAGES GUILD. 
DEY NO EASILY TAKE NEW ASSOCIATES, BUT YOU IZ ALREADY ONE, SO YOU IZ FREE TA ENTER.
JUST A WARNIN': DEY NO LIKE YOU AT ALL!

m689_zone6.title: SHOP TUNNEL
m689_zone6.text: DERE IZ MANY STORES BELOW DIS TUNNEL, AN' IT IZ CONNECTED WIT DA OTHER SIDE OF DA CITY!

m704_zone.title: CLOCKTOWER DUNGEON
m704_zone.text: WE ACTUALLY ALREADY BEAT DIS DUNGEON SOME YEARS AGO, BUT SINCE IT HAB BEEN RESET COUNTLESS TIMES, IT CAN BE GOOD PRACTICE TA REGAIN SOME DUNGEON SENSE!

m704_zone2.title: TRAININ' CENTER
m704_zone2.text: IT IZ A TRAININ' CENTER, BUT WHO NEEDS IT HONESTLY? ME CAN BE A BETTER TUTOR DEN DOZE [ARCHIVIST] NERDS. DID YOU KNOW DEY STOLE ME ORIGINAL DRAWIN' SHEET FOR DA [LIMINAL ENGINE] AN' SENT ME A PHOTOCOPY? DEY WORK EXACTLY LIKE DA [GREAT ALEXANDRIA LIBRARY]: DEY KEEP DA ORIGINALS AN' SEND YOU WASHED OUT COPIES!

m704_zone3.title: BUS STOP
m704_zone3.text: WE CAN USE BUS STOPS TA MOVE BETWEEN ANY LOCATIONS IN DA WORLD!

m704_zone4.title: FAIRY MAZE
m704_zone4.text: FAIRIES IZ DANGEROUS, EM! DEY IZ LIVIN' INFOHAZARDS, AN' YOU NO CAN JUST IGNORE DEM LIKE DA PEOPLE ON TV. YOU NEED TA RESPOND TA DEM, BE POLITE AN' NEVER EVER ACCEPT SOMETHIN' FROM DEM, JUST REFUSE... POLITELY!

m708_zone.title: WILDERNESS
m708_zone.text: GOING AHEAD YOU CAN CHOOSE TA RETURN TA DA WORLD MAP OR EXPLORE DA WILDERNESS AROUND GHENT!

m1414_zone13.title: DIVIN'
m1414_zone13.text: ME SPOTTED A TREASURE UNDER DIS POND; YOU CAN DIVE TA REACH IT. REMEMBER DAT WHEN FIGHTIN' IN WATER, YOU AN' DA BAD 'UNS TAKE EXTRA DAMAGE FROM ELECTRICAL ATTACKS!

m1414_zone15.title: ESOTERIC SHOP
m1414_zone15.text: IN [ESOTERIC SHOPS] YOU CAN BUY MAGICAL EQUIPMENT, ALCHEMISTRY KITS AN' REAGENTS. DID YOU KNOW DAT DA OWNER OF DIS SHOP WORKED AT [CERN]?

m1414_zone16.title: ARMORY SHOP
m1414_zone16.text: VISIT ARMORIES AN' GUN SHOPS TA BUY NEW WEAPONS AN' GEAR DAT YOU CAN EQUIP IN DA [EQUIP] SECTION OF [MENU]!

m1414_zone17.title: WILDERNESS
m1414_zone17.text: GOING AHEAD YOU CAN CHOOSE TA RETURN TA DA WORLD MAP OR EXPLORE DA WILDERNESS AROUND ICEBUSH!

m1414_zone18.title: WILDERNESS
m1414_zone18.text: GOING AHEAD YOU CAN CHOOSE TA RETURN TA DA WORLD MAP OR EXPLORE DA WILDERNESS AROUND ICEBUSH!

m1414_zone19.title: WILDERNESS
m1414_zone19.text: GOING AHEAD YOU CAN CHOOSE TA RETURN TA DA WORLD MAP OR EXPLORE DA WILDERNESS AROUND ICEBUSH!

m1414_zone20.title: SLIMES
m1414_zone20.text:
EVERY SLIME HAB A PARTICULAR ELEMENTAL WEAKNESS AN' RESISTS PHYSICAL ATTACKS.
ACCORDIN' TA YA CLASS SHEET, YOU SHOULD RELEARN SOME ELEMENTAL SPELLS REAL SOON!

m1414_zone21.title: BLOCK PUSHIN' PUZZLE
m1414_zone21.text:
OHH ANOTHER BLOCK PUSHIN' PUZZLE!
MOVE TOWARD DAT BOULDER TA PUSH IT AN' HOLD [SHIFT] TA DRAG IT WIT YOU!

m1415_zone.title: BLOCK PUSHIN' PUZZLE
m1415_zone.text:
A BLOCK PUSHIN' PUZZLE PLUS AN ICE FLOOR! CAN YOU SOLVE IT FOR ME, EM? ME NEED TA TEST YA PUZZLE SOLVIN' SKILLS TA DETERMINE HOW MUCH OF YOU IZ LEFT IN YA SOUL.
MOVE TOWARD DAT BOULDER TA PUSH IT AN' HOLD [OK] TA DRAG IT WIT YOU

m1415_zone2.title: PRE Y2K CACHE
m1415_zone2.text: DIS IZ A CACHE OF ITEMS LOCKED SINCE DA Y2K! LETZ LOOT EVERYTHIN', AN' BE CAREFUL NO TA BE OVERENCUMBERED BY ALL DA LOOT. CARRYIN' CAPACITY INCREASES WIT YA [COS] AN' WIT MORE PARTY MEMBERS FOLLOWIN'!

m1415_zone3.title: UNFINISHED PUZZLE
m1415_zone3.text: ME THINK DA GUY WHO BUILT DIS DUNGEON RAN OUT OF FUNDS WHEN BUILDIN' DIS ROOM, BUT IT WAZ REAL PROMISIN'!

m1415_zone4.title: ICE BLOCK PUZZLE
m1415_zone4.text: SOLVIN' DIS OTHER PUZZLE SHOULD GIVE ME A BASELINE READIN' OF YA PUZZLE SOLVIN' SKILLS, IF YOU WANT MORE COMPLEX PUZZLES TA SOLVE WE CAN HEAD TA DA [TRICK CASTLE]!

m1415_zone5.title: HIGH LEVEL BAD 'UNS
m1415_zone5.text: DERE IZ A SWARM OF CRYODRONES TRAPPED IN DIS CAVE. DEY IZ ABOVE OUR CURRENT COMBAT LEVEL, SO WE SHOULD MOVE PAST DEM AN' RUN IF WE END UP IN BATTLE WIT DEM. YOU NO WANT TA GET FROZEN SOLID, AN' NEITHER DO ME!

m1415_zone6.title: FOG OF WAR
m1415_zone6.text: YOU CAN ACTIVATE DA [FOG OF WAR] IN [FIDDLY BITS] TA REMOVE YA GLASSES AN' HAB YA VISION LIMITED. IT IZ YA CHOICE, REALLY!

m503_zone.title: UNDERGROUND ARENA
m503_zone.text: WE CAN EARN SOME SERIOUS EUROS BY FIGHTIN' IN DA ARENA: WE CAN BRING OUR OWN EQUIPMENT OR BORROW WEAPONS FROM DA ARENA STASH!

m635_zone.title: DUNGEON ENTRANCE
m635_zone.text:
DIS IZ DA MAIN STAIRCASE. ABOVE US IZ 92 FLOORS ROBBED FROM 92 DIFFERENT DIMENSIONS AN' SKEWERED ON DA TOWER.
AN' UNDER US DERE IZ ANOTHER 92 UNDERGROUND FLOORS, EVEN MORE BRUTAL DEN DA UPPER ONES!

m635_zone2.title: DA HALL
m635_zone2.text: INACTIVE PARTY MEMBERS WILL JUST CHILL OUT HERE IF YOU NO ASSIGN DEM TA OWNED BUILDINGS OR BASES IN DA [DYNAMICS] MENU. YOU CAN ASK DEM TA JOIN OUR PARTY IF YOU HAB A FREE SPOT!

m1073_zone.title: PLATFORMIN'
m1073_zone.text: DIS TOWER HAB A DIMENSIONAL ANOMALY CAUSED BY DA [SQUISHIN']. ME IZ FEELIN' REAL BIDIMENSIONAL!

m689_zone7.title: CASINO
m689_zone7.text:
DIS IZ DA GHENT CASINO, EM! 
YOU LOVED GAMBLIN' HERE BEFORE YA MIND GOT WIPED. 
ME THINK DA WHOLE DEICIDE SPELL BACKFIRIN' CURED YOU OF YA LUDOPATHY!

m708_zone2.title: EXPLORERS BAR
m708_zone2.text: ME LOVE DIS LIL' BAR. DA OWNER IZ UNDEAD AN' IZ CURSED TA SERVE HERE FOR ALL ETERNITY... WELL, AT LEAST UNTIL 2012, WHEN DERE WILL BE NO EARTH ANYMORE. HE MAINTAINS DA NEAPOLITAN TRADITION OF DA SUSPENDED COFFEE!

m714_zone.title: HYPERMODERN ART
m714_zone.text: IT MAY SEEM LIKE A HEIST, BUT IT IZ JUST HYPERMODERN ART!

m721_zone2.title: RETURNIN' TEMPLE
m721_zone2.text: RING DA GONG TA RETURN TA DA OMEGA TOWER, NO MATTER HOW DISTANT WE IZ FROM EARTH!

m721_zone3.title: SPACE EXPLORATION
m721_zone3.text:
HERE WE IZ, EM! DA FINAL FRONTIER! PRESS [OK] IN FRONT OF DA CONSOLE DA [STAR MAP] TA PLOT OUR NEXT COURSE. 
ME TALKED WIT COMMANDER HACK; HE TRUSTS ME ENOUGH TA PILOT DIS THING.
ALSO WE IZ AUTHORIZED TA USE DA TELEPORT SO WE NO HAB TA GO TROUGH DA KESSLER FIELD AN' RISK OUR LIFE FOR NOTHIN'!

m1036_zone.title: STOCK FIDDLY BITS
m1036_zone.text:
BUYIN' LIME CORP STOCKS IZ A GOOD STARTIN' POINT IF YOU WANT TA START INVESTIN'. 
YOU CAN BUY AN' SELL IN DA STOCKS [HYPERDECK] APP.
PRICES OF DA VARIOUS STOCKS AFFECT DA DAILY PRICE OF EACH ITEM WE CAN BUY IN STORES!

m1036_zone2.title: CRIME AN' PUNISHMENT
m1036_zone2.text: REMEMBER, EM: DA POLICE SERVE JUSTICE, SO DEY AUTOMATICALLY SERVE ERIS, ME EX-WIFE. IF YOU COMMIT A CRIME AN' DEY CATCH YOU, PAY YA BOUNTY OR GO TA PRISON; NEVER FACE ERIS DIRECTLY. SHE HATES YA GUTS!

m1036_zone3.title: HELICOPTER RIDE
m1036_zone3.text: WE CAN BOOK A HELICOPTER RIDE TA DA OMEGA TOWER FROM DIS HELICOPTER PAD!

m1039_zone.title: CURSIN' TEMPLE
m1039_zone.text:
ME READ IN DA GHENT TOURIST GUIDE DAT IF YOU EVEN PUT A FOOT IN DIS TEMPLE YOU WILL BE CURSED. 
DA GUIDE NO STATE DA NATURE OF DA CURSE!

m1415_zone7.title: LOCKED DOORS
m1415_zone7.text:
DEZE TYPES OF DOORS IZ FUELED DIRECTLY BY DA LEYLINE AN' NO CAN BE OPENED WITHOUT A [DUNGEON KEY].
DA GOOD THING IZ DAT WE CAN USE ANY DUNGEON KEY WIT ANY OF DEZE DOORS IN ANY PLACE IN DA UNIVERSE!

m1415_zone8.title: INNER WATERFALL
m1415_zone8.text: ME TOLD YOU, EM! DERE WAZ A SECRET CAVE AN' AN EVEN SECRETER WATERFALL ALL ALONG!

m1415_zone9.title: BEAR MAULIN' CAVE
m1415_zone9.text: HOLY HEXIN' SHIT, WE IZ GETTIN' MAULED BY A BEAR LIKE ME TOLD YOU!!! RUN!

m169_zone5.title: HYPERVIOLENCE
m169_zone5.text: WE NO HAB TA PUNCH NEW HOLES INTO EVERY BAD 'UN WE ENCOUNTER EM, USE DA [TALK] OPTION IN BATTLE TA USE DIPLOMACY!

m721_zone4.title: SHUTTLE BAY
m721_zone4.text: IF WE NEED TA ABANDONSHIP OR WE WANT TA RETURN TA EARTH WIT STYLE!

m721_zone5.title: TELEVISION
m721_zone5.text: DIS TELEVISION HAB PRERECORDED EPISODES BECAUSE ONCE WE IZ FAR FROM EARTH DA SIGNAL NO CAN REACH US. REMEMBER EM, WE NO KNOW EXACTLY DA NATURE OF YA INFOHAZARD SO NO RESPOND EVEN TA PRERECORDED FOOTAGE OK?

m1006_zone5.title: POOL TABLE
m1006_zone5.text: WANNA PLAY POOL, EM? ME DO!

m1414_zone6.title: ICEBUSH
m1414_zone6.text:
USE DA [EMPATHIZE] OPTION WHEN TALKIN' TA PEOPLE TA MAKE NEW MATE, BAD 'UNS, LOVERS OR...FRENEMIES???
BUT WAIT, DERE IZ MORE.
YOU CAN INFLUENCE DA POLITICAL OPINION OF PEOPLE, PLAY CARD WIT DEM, PICKPOCKET DEM, ANYTHIN' SOCIALLY ACCEPTABLE AN' NO SHOULD BE DERE,

m1414_zone8.title: QUICK CHECK
m1414_zone8.text:
BEFORE WE CONTINUE OUR ADVENTURE EM, LETZ DO SOME QUICK CHECKS.
FIRST CHECK DA [EQUIP] FIDDLY BITS AN' [SKILL] OPTION IN [MENU] TA CHANGE YA EQUIPMENT AN' SKILLS YOU CARRY IN BATTLE.
YOU CAN HAB UP TA 9 SKILLS AN' SPELLS IN BATTLE!

m635_zone3.title: MISSILE LAUNCH RAILGUN
m635_zone3.text: IF WE PROVE OUR WORTHINESS BY SURVIVIN' AN ORBITAL ASCENT THROUGH DA KESSLER FIELD, WE GAIN DA RIGHT TA TELEPORT DIRECTLY TA DA ESA SHIP ORBITIN' OUTSIDE DA BELT. ME IZ A BIG FAN OF [DIRECTOR HACK], WHO IZ DA HEAD OF [ESA]. DID YOU KNOW DAT SHE IZ STILL AN ATHEIST EVEN THOUGH DA EXISTENCE OF MULTIPLE GODS HAB BEEN CONFIRMED? SHE IZ SO BADASS!

m635_zone4.title: ELEVATOR
m635_zone4.text: WE CAN USE DA ELEVATOR TA RETURN TA ANY FLOOR WE FIRST REACHED ON FOOT, PLUS DA HYPERMETRO STATION AN' OMEGA CITY MANY FLOORS DOWN. DA ELEVATOR IZ SENTIENT: IT CAN RECOGNIZE FACES AN' LOCK FLOORS BASED ON WHO VISITS!

m635_zone5.title: HYPERMETRO STAIRS
m635_zone5.text: USE DEZE STAIRS TA REACH DA HYPERMETRO STATION!

m102_zone.title: ELEVATOR
m102_zone.text: DIS IZ DA MAIN ELEVATOR, WE CAN USE IT TA REACH ANY DISCOVERED FLOOR OF DIS TOWER!

m102_zone2.title: TRAININ' CENTER
m102_zone2.text: DID YOU SEE DA TRAININ' CENTER AT GHENT? IN REALITY IT IZ A FAKE BUILDIN' DAT, ON ENTRY, TRANSPORTS YOU TA DA INTERIOR OF DIS TRAININ' CENTER. ME WAZ HIRED TA DESIGN DA MECHANISM; IT IZ NO MAGICAL, IT IZ PURE PHYSICS!

m1414_zone14.title: CAMPER
m1414_zone14.text:
HERE IZ OUR RV, DA [BEAST]!
WE CAN USE IT TA GO ANYWHERE WE WANT, IN ANY PLANET, IN ANY DIMENSION.
ME HAB SOME UPGRADES PENDIN', LIKE INSULATIN' IT TA MAKE IT GO UNDERWATER, YOU CAN UPGRADE DA CAMPER FROM [MENU] AN' [VEHICLES].
AN' IF WE LEAVE IT BEHIND WE CAN SUMMON IT TOGETHER BY JOININ' OUR LIMINAL CUFFS!

m1414_zone22.title: BEAR MAULIN' CAVE
m1414_zone22.text: DIS IZ DA FAMOUS [BEAR MAULIN' CAVE], WE SHOULD PROBABLY AVOID IT!

findTheInn.title: SOMEWHERE TA SLEEP
findTheInn.text: DA INN STANDS AT DA MIDDLE OF DA STATION. FOLLOW DA LIT WINDOWS AN' ASK DA LANDLORD FOR A BED!

seeTheDoctor.title: SEE DA DOCTOR
seeTheDoctor.text: DA CLINIC IZ DA LOW BUILDIN' WIT DA WHITE DOOR. WHATEVER IZ BROKEN GETS SET IN DERE!

searchTheWagons.title: SEARCH DA WAGONS
searchTheWagons.text: DA SIDIN' HAB NO BEEN PICKED CLEAN. OPEN EVERY CRATE BEFORE DA LIGHT GOES!

intoTheCaves.title: INTO DA CAVES
intoTheCaves.text: DA MOUTH IN DA HILL RUNS DEEPER DEN IT LOOKS. TAKE A LIGHT, AN' SOMETHIN' TA SWING!

headOutside.title: HEAD OUTSIDE
headOutside.text: DERE IZ NOTHIN' MORE FOR YOU INDOORS. STEP OUT AN' TAKE DA ROAD!
